'''Jungle Planks''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds a [[Crafting Table]] recipe (from 2 × [[Jungle Slab]]) and two [[Stonecutter]] recipes. See {{MCW|Jungle Planks}} for everything else.
